856-3899-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

512-950-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-4314--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-4314--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2692-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2692-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-2907-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-2907-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

856-2558-3899-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-3899-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

4871-5220-6495-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4871-5220-6495-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6495-6650.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-6495-6650.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

765-5226-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

330-6861-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
Sawhorn Nemesis is naming you.
330-6861-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Sawhorn Nemesis.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-7060-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2187-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Possessed Skaab.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from exile to the battlefield.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2919-6458-7690--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2919-6458-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3094-7685.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Arc Reactor and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Arc Reactor and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3688-4478-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-4478-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3499-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

423-1437-3147-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3147-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-5477-7296.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1486-1651-5776.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

1379-4659-5003-7273.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Unlucky Cabbage Merchant, as it's an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, adding {C}{C}.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Unlucky Cabbage Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant enters, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Unlucky Cabbage Merchant's second ability triggers. Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger from step 5, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped. You will not shuffle Unlucky Cabbage Merchant as it's a new object.
Repeat from step 4.

4499-4747-7175.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

457-1329-3338-4908-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

586-5147-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4476-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4476-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2423-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Bounding Krasis.
When Bounding Krasis enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

222-527-997-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2829-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
2829-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1636-5686-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-5686-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

5413-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5413-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

813-2103-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Splash Portal.
813-2103-5895.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

222-2921-4871-5221.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1992-4050-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-4050-5994.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding one mana of any color.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Repeat.

1365-4050-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4050-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher, adding one mana of any color.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

413-2281-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Havi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

101-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Vampire Charmseeker.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Vampire Charmseeker.
Repeat from step 2.

1323-4029-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4029-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

891-1585-2511-2523.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-1585-2511-2523.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1459-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1459-2092-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galadriel.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose any of Galadriel's modes.

2696-2781-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact, a creature, and/or a land that can tap to produce at least {3}{C}.
2696-2781-4013.description:
Activate a mana-producing artifact, creature, and/or land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping the mana-producing permanents and causing you to gain two life.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Teferi.
Repeat.
